title: Things around me
summary: Name everyday things, say 'the' with الـ and describe things as new or big.
intro: Arabic has no word for 'a': كِتَاب is 'a book'. 'The' is الـ joined to the front: الْكِتَاب. Adjectives come after the noun and add ة for a feminine noun: سَيَّارَة جَدِيدَة (a new car). New letters: ف ق ك ل.
objectives: Say 'the' with الـ, with sun and moon letters
Describe a noun with جَدِيد and كَبِير
Read and write fāʾ, qāf, kāf and lām

realLife.title: A forgotten bag
realLife.story: Daniel arrives with a brand-new Arabic textbook, but he has left his bag, and his pen, at home. Layla lends him a pen, and Sami spots a new car outside the school.

mistakes.why: sayyāra is feminine, so the adjective takes ة too.

dialogue.title: Where is your pen?
dialogue.culture: تَفَضَّلْ (to a man) or تَفَضَّلِي (to a woman) is the polite word for 'here you are', 'please come in' or 'please sit down'.

lines.ar: صَبَاحُ الْخَيْر يَا دَانْيَال! مَا هٰذَا؟ هَلْ هٰذَا كِتَاب جَدِيد؟
lines.en: Good morning, Daniel! What is this? Is this a new book?

lines.ar: نَعَم، هٰذَا كِتَابُ الْعَرَبِيَّة الْجَدِيد. هُوَ كَبِير جِدًّا!
lines.en: Yes, this is the new Arabic book. It is very big!
The book is beautiful! And where is your pen?

lines.ar: قَلَمِي فِي الْحَقِيبَة… لَا، الْحَقِيبَة فِي الْبَيْت!
lines.en: My pen is in the bag… no, the bag is at home!

lines.ar: لَا مُشْكِلَة! عِنْدِي قَلَم آخَر. تَفَضَّلْ!
lines.en: No problem! I have another pen. Here you are!

lines.ar: شُكْرًا جَزِيلًا يَا لَيْلَى! الْقَلَم جَدِيد؟
lines.en: Thank you very much, Layla! Is the pen new?

lines.ar: نَعَم، الْقَلَم جَدِيد، وَالْحَقِيبَة جَدِيدَة أَيْضًا.
lines.en: Yes, the pen is new, and my bag is new too.

lines.ar: حَقِيبَتُكِ جَمِيلَة! هَلْ هِيَ مِنْ لُبْنَان؟
lines.en: Your bag is beautiful! Is it from Lebanon?

lines.ar: لَا، هِيَ مِنْ مِصْر، مِنْ سُوق كَبِير فِي الْقَاهِرَة.
lines.en: No, it is from Egypt, from a big market in Cairo.

lines.ar: مَرْحَبًا! هَلْ هٰذِهِ سَيَّارَةُ الْأُسْتَاذ عِنْدَ الْبَاب؟
lines.en: Hello! Is this the teacher's car by the door?

lines.ar: نَعَم، هِيَ سَيَّارَةُ الْأُسْتَاذ كَرِيم. سَيَّارَة كَبِيرَة!
lines.en: Yes, it is Mr Karim's car. What a big car!
And the teacher is here! Come on, the lesson starts now.

reading.title: In the classroom
reading.ar: فِي الصَّفّ بَاب كَبِير. عَلَى الطَّاوِلَة كِتَاب جَدِيد وَقَلَم. الْحَقِيبَة الْكَبِيرَة لِلْأُسْتَاذ.
reading.en: In the classroom there is a big door. On the table there is a new book and a pen. The big bag belongs to the teacher.

quiz.prompt: Choose the correct sentence: 'The bag is big.'
In the word for 'the car', the l of the article is …
options: silent, because s is a sun letter
pronounced, because s is a moon letter

quiz.prompt: Which letter is the deep k, said at the uvula?
In the dialogue, what did Daniel leave at home?

completion: Fantastic! You can name things, use 'the' and describe things. Twenty-three letters learned.
